answer: Rolling-window contribution floor resists sybils: an identity retains standing only if its verified work over the trailing N epochs stays above a floor, so dormant or hit-and-run fakes drop out automatically. A ripple of one-time activity cannot hold a seat — the fable that a fake can earn once and coast dies against the moving floor, and influence rests on a mesa of sustained recent work. A swarm must keep every identity continuously above the floor, a relentless per-head cost that idle fakes cannot meet.
